ayahOccurrences.text: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ضَامِرٍ is in the derivative form: ضَامِرٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ض/م/ر   ḍ–m–r race course, slimming down of horses in preparation for a race or battle, (of the body) to be slender, to be emaciated, to weaken; hidden secrets, to conceal. Of this root, ضَامِرٌ ḍāmir, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ضَامِرٌ ḍāmir [act. part.] emaciated, shrunk, lean

(22:27) وَأَذِّنْ‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏النَّاسِ‏ ‏بِالْحَجِّ‏ ‏يَأْتُوكَ‏ ‏رِجَالاً‏ ‏وَعَلَى‏ ‏كُلِّ‏ ‏ضَامِرٍ‏‏ proclaim the Pilgrimage to humankind; they will come to you on foot, and on every [kind of] emaciated [mount].
